summary: The Relevance Gate keeps its own instruction: the tool list added yesterday measured worse and is not shipped.
details: Giving the gate her derived read-only tool surface was shipped on the theory that it judges a capability question blind. Measured over the eval suite's 40 labelled windows it made the gate stricter and worse — false NO_GO 3 to 5, two capabilities lost cases, and 707 extra prompt tokens on every quiet window in every opted-in room.

The digest renderer had a real defect while it was live: it took the first LINE and then the first sentence, so any description whose opening sentence wrapped was cut mid-clause. Five of thirty-four lines were amputated, including the two verbs that reach messages older than the visible window.
The eval suite can now be told to include the digest, so the next attempt at this is measured before it is deployed rather than after.
participation.md no longer points at a list it is not given, and says plainly that its five shapes are to be judged, not matched.
limitations: The gate still cannot learn what Nora holds from prose — three rewrites tried and every one lost whole capabilities. What it knows still comes from the shapes named in its instruction.
Accuracy is unchanged at 3 false NO_GO of 40; this change buys coherence and cost, not precision.
